title: Net Zero 2.0
tagline: An institutional Fund raising platform for renewable energy using governance and auditing
description: Net Zero 2.0 is web3 app that empowers everyone to transparently participate in fair voting, and crowdfund impactful environmental projects for corporate fund allocation. We aimed to solve the existing problems with climate project funding by utilising the transparent, trustless and seamless nature of the blockchain leveraging the technologies available on the superchain ecosystem.
how_its_made: We leveraged a range of technologies to achieve our mission. These included; Base, EAS, Worldcoin, Thirdweb, Tenderly, Farcaster and Blockscout. This made it possible to build an application with decentralised voting, fund allocation and reputation points. We also have a voter leaderboard to encourage competition and engagement . The benefit from using our project is  enabling institutional users to vote on-chain,  provide a higher chance for projects to get fully funded and seamless, transparent flow of funds stored in a vault.
